mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% signals excessive inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tight labor market that accelerates wage inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and reduce equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) during a late-cycle economic expansion signal robust consumer demand and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 growth and HOUST increases fails to predict positive returns in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle, indicated by rising FEDFUNDS, signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising in a tightening cycle, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
